video_title: Wemby & Harrison Barnes Try Rugby in France!

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the team spirit of the rugby players
quotes.excerpt: I think the team I went with was so good that it's like if they tried to come play basketball with us.
quotes.quote: I think the team I went with was so good that it's like if they tried to come play basketball with us.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the inspiring team culture of rugby players
quotes.excerpt: It was a great experience seeing the kind of team spirit they have over there, very inspiring.
quotes.quote: It was a great experience seeing the kind of team spirit they have over there, very inspiring. The way the relationships between teammates and coaches and fans, it was so interesting for me. The training in itself was really hard. I think it was really good for the vestibular system and new movement patterns and new ways to develop strength as well.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on being welcomed by the rugby team
quotes.excerpt: I'm more grateful for the experience in itself and how I was welcomed there.
quotes.quote: I'm more grateful for the experience in itself and how I was welcomed there. I've never been welcomed like this anywhere. I'm not part of the team and they treated me like I was, so amazing experience.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his offseason training goals
quotes.excerpt: Every summer, I try to do something to make myself a better player, do something out of the normal.
quotes.quote: Every summer, I try to do something to make myself a better player, do something out of the normal. This year it was rugby, so to be able to go out there, practice with those guys, kind of just see a different level of physicality, obviously coming from the playoffs last year, the game was very physical.

quotes.speaker: Harrison Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Harrison Barnes on the athleticism of rugby players
quotes.excerpt: Rugby players are some of the most athletic talented individuals I've seen just in the sport up close.
quotes.quote: Rugby players are some of the most athletic talented individuals I've seen just in the sport up close, and so it was great to be able to train with those guys.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the challenge of rugby training
quotes.excerpt: Rarely I've been put in situations where I was so far from being able to play.
quotes.quote: It was super impressive. Rarely I've been put in situations where I was so far from being able to play, from being game ready. No, it was great. Trying to, it's so different, so many different type of stimulations for the brain and for the body, so super interesting as always to do again. I want to do it again.
